codexSidebar.parserMode.description: Streaming parser mode. Use legacy for quick rollback if parsing regression occurs.

codexSidebar.showToolUsageIndicator.description: Show tool usage count in the Thinking Process summary and highlight it when tools were used.

enumDescriptions: Show only tool/command cards in steps
Show all model output including text and tool cards in steps
codexSidebar.stepDetailLevel.description: Detail level for step display. Compact shows only commands/tools, Full shows all model output.

codexSidebar.codexThinkingNoiseFilterEna.description: Filter low-value Codex thinking lines (e.g. Planning/Preparing headings) before rendering.

codexSidebar.codexHideThinking.description: Hide thinking process output for Codex. When enabled, only the final answer will be shown.

codexSidebar.codexAutoResumeSession.description: Automatically resume the previous Codex exec session for follow-up requests.

codexSidebar.claudeAutoResumeSession.description: Automatically resume the previous Claude session for follow-up requests.

codexSidebar.claudeDisableThinking.description: Disable thinking process output for Claude. When enabled, Claude will not show its reasoning process.

codexSidebar.claudeModel.description: Model for Claude CLI. Supports aliases (sonnet, opus) or full names. Maps to --model flag. Leave empty to use default.

codexSidebar.claudeAgent.description: Agent type for Claude session (e.g., custom reviewer). Maps to --agent flag. Leave empty to use default.

codexSidebar.claudeTools.description: Available tools for Claude. Empty string disables tools, 'default' for all, or specify like 'Bash,Edit,Read'. Maps to --tools flag. Leave empty to use default.

enumDescriptions: Allow skipping permission checks during runtime (--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions)
codexSidebar.claudePermissionMode.description: Permission check mode for Claude CLI.

codexSidebar.piAutoResumeSession.description: Automatically resume the previous Pi session for follow-up requests.

codexSidebar.piDisableThinking.description: Disable thinking process output for Pi. When enabled, Pi will not show its reasoning process.

codexSidebar.piModel.description: Model ID for Pi CLI (e.g., gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro). Leave empty to use Pi's default.

codexSidebar.piApiKey.description: API key for Pi CLI. Leave empty to use environment variable.

codexSidebar.piThinkingLevel.description: Thinking depth level for Pi CLI. Use 'default' to not specify (uses Pi's default).

codexSidebar.codexEnforceCheckpointPolic.description: Inject a system policy asking Codex to create a checkpoint before file edits.

codexSidebar.codexRequireHardCheckpoint.description: Create a real workspace snapshot checkpoint before every Codex request and block execution when checkpoint creation fails.

codexSidebar.codexHardCheckpointRetentio.description: Maximum number of hard checkpoint snapshots kept in extension global storage.

enumDescriptions: Use the current active provider (Codex/Claude/Pi) to generate session titles
Always use a fixed provider to generate session titles
Use the first user message as the session title
codexSidebar.titleGenerationMode.description: How to generate session titles automatically.

codexSidebar.titleFixedProvider.description: The fixed provider to use for title generation when titleGenerationMode is set to 'fixedProvider'.

codexSidebar.codexConfigOverrides.description: Override Codex config values (e.g., 'model=o3'). Maps to -c/--config flag.

codexSidebar.codexModel.description: Model for Codex Agent (e.g., o3, gpt-4). Maps to -m/--model flag. Leave empty to use default.

codexSidebar.codexOss.description: Use local open source model provider (LM Studio, Ollama). Maps to --oss flag.

codexSidebar.codexProfile.description: Use a preset configuration profile from Codex config. Maps to -p/--profile flag. Leave empty to use default.

enumDescriptions: Read-only mode - no file modifications allowed
Allow writing to workspace directory only
Full access - dangerous, allows all operations
codexSidebar.codexSandboxMode.description: Sandbox policy for shell command execution. Maps to -s/--sandbox flag.

enumDescriptions: Only ask for approval on untrusted commands (non ls, cat, etc.)
Only ask for approval when execution fails
Never ask for approval (directly feedback errors to model)
codexSidebar.codexApprovalPolicy.description: When to require human approval for command execution. Maps to -a/--ask-for-approval flag.

codexSidebar.codexFullAuto.description: Enable full auto mode (equivalent to -a on-request --sandbox workspace-write). Maps to --full-auto flag.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.check:strict: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run test && npm run security:check
